item.title: Farmer who killed lodger and hid body in concrete in South Yorkshire jailed for life
item.summary: Christopher Wright, 73, who shot Richard Dyson and dismembered his remains, given 35-year minimum term A man who killed his lodger and concealed his dismembered body in a barrel filled with concrete for more than five years has been jailed for a minimum of 35 years. Christopher Wright, a 73-year-old farmer from South Yorkshire, was convicted in July in Sheffield crown court of murdering Richard Dyson, 55, in 2019. Continue reading...
